title: Implement notifications model and pollable delivery queue
description:
Create chatbot/agency/notifications.py implementing a Notification dataclass, a pollable in-memory delivery queue, and standard enqueue/dequeue/list/read/dismiss operations. Notifications cover reminders, emotional check-ins, continuation prompts, milestone callbacks, and event callbacks.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/architecture.md
- chatbot/agency/__init__.py (created by task a.1)
- chatbot/agency/checkins.py (created by task a.2 — understand CheckInType and CheckIn dataclass)
- chatbot/agency/initiative.py (created by task a.4 — understand InitiativeLevel enum for gating)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY chatbot/agency/notifications.py. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance.

Implementation:

1. chatbot/agency/notifications.py:
  - NotificationType literal: 'reminder', 'emotional_checkin', 'continuation_prompt', 'milestone', 'event_callback'.
  - Notification dataclass: notification_id (str), user_id (str), notif_type (NotificationType), title (str), body (str), created_at (str, ISO timestamp), read (bool default False), dismissed (bool default False), metadata (dict default_factory=dict).
  - NotificationQueue class:
    * In-memory queue (dict[str, list[Notification]] keyed by user_id).
    * enqueue(user_id, notification, initiative_level) respects initiative gating: returns False when 'never', only allows reminder/milestone for 'reminders_only'.
    * dequeue(user_id) returns the oldest unread/undismissed notification or None.
    * poll(user_id, since=None) returns list of notifications for user, optionally filtered to those after a since timestamp.
    * mark_read(notification_id) / dismiss(notification_id) update notification state; return False for unknown IDs.
    * pending_count(user_id) returns count of unread/undismissed notifications.
  - No push, email, or SMS integration. No persistence to database in v1.
acceptance_criteria: chatbot/agency/notifications.py exists and defines NotificationType, Notification, NotificationQueue
Notification has notification_id, user_id, notif_type, title, body, created_at, read, dismissed, metadata fields
NotificationQueue.enqueue() returns False when initiative is 'never'
NotificationQueue.enqueue() only allows 'reminder' and 'milestone' types for 'reminders_only'
NotificationQueue.dequeue() returns the oldest unread/undismissed notification
NotificationQueue.poll() supports since timestamp filtering and returns empty list for empty queue
NotificationQueue.mark_read() and dismiss() return False for unknown notification_id
NotificationQueue.pending_count() returns count of unread/undismissed notifications
No push, email, or SMS integration
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: integrate push notification infrastructure, email, SMS, or external delivery services
change the Abracapocus runtime, orchestrator, or backends

allowed: use in-memory queue (dict[str, list]) for v1
declare methods as async for future database-backed compatibility
respect initiative level gating in enqueue()
forbidden: add threading locks, multiprocessing, or distributed queue primitives
add notification expiration or TTL logic
